name: flintrail
description: Drive a real Chrome live, record a flow once, replay it in milliseconds without an LLM.
long_description: Flintrail is a fast browser MCP server. It attaches to your own Chrome (or launches one), acts on pages through compact accessibility snapshots, records a flow once and replays it in milliseconds without calling a model, and can skip the UI entirely by replaying the site's own API calls. A companion Chrome extension lets it drive your everyday browser profile.
